panels.description: Colorado CSG facility: Roman sits at a worktable with a hospital treatment schedule, an unapproved T-ALL chemistry file, and a months-scale deterioration marker. His bonded TJ stands beside the papers. Leave upper area clear.
Croft places his medical-alert bracelet beside the file without touching Roman. Keep his expression controlled and exhausted. Leave upper third clear for two balloons.
Croft turns the treatment schedule so Roman can see the date. Roman remains seated and tense. Leave upper third clear for Croft’s balloon.
Roman signs a restricted-access form. His bonded TJ’s green-black display reads LOCAL PARTITION: STATUS PULSE. Roman’s hand remains on the pen after signing. Leave lower-right clear for his balloon.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: The approved route is too slow.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: By the time it is approved, there may be no patient left to approve it for.

items.speaker: ROMAN
items.text: I’ll run the chemistry. I keep the records.
